historical_source_policy: exact archived bytes for authorization and contract; every other predecessor source/evidence remains current and byte-identical
acl_policy: skip InheritOnly only on its current object; independently inspect all five actual objects; never skip effective IsInherited ACEs; reject dangerous ordinary Allow even with Deny; reject generic writes and unsupported states
metadata_policy: fixed literal trust paths; Force hidden metadata only; reject missing/null/unsupported DACL, untrusted owner, aliases, reparse/offline/recall paths and multi-link registry
review_policy: new reviewed regular merge descendant of predecessor required; predecessor merge/head/fingerprint cannot authorize successor
scientific_policy: predecessor scientific contract, environment and 72 model/threshold specifications exact; B1/B2/audit/split/development/calibration unchanged
during_this_assignment: engineering and synthetic ACL/artificial activation tests only; no dataset, registry installation, keys, real approval/claim, inference/evaluation or power/ACL changes
